messages:
maria: Heads up — spotted a reproducible SDK init + auth retry stampede on Android 13 when app uses certificate pinning + okhttp connection pooling. Sample app attached to the ticket.
kevin: ack. Can you paste the minimal log? curious if it's double-refresh or duplicate requests from interceptor.
maria: logs show two parallel token refresh flows and ~5 duplicate downstream calls within ~200ms after network reconnect. snippet:
```
I/OkHttp: <-- 401 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
D/Auth: refresh started (correlation=xyz)
D/Auth: refresh started (correlation=abc)
I/OkHttp: --> POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (cloned)
```
chloe: that looks like our authenticator is being invoked concurrently because the original call completes but clone() is used in retry path. we had a similar race but not with pinning.
sam: Could pinning be interfering with connection reuse and forcing handshake that triggers auth header removal? also android 13 changed TLS defaults.
kevin: I reproduced locally on Pixel 6 emulator. The root cause: our OkHttpAuthenticator uses a non-atomic check for expired token and then launches a refresh coroutine that doesn't block other threads, so second request also thinks token expired and triggers another refresh.
maria: Yup. Also ProGuard in sample app obfuscated the synchronized helper so it silently dropped the mutex; that made it even worse in prod for some customers.
chloe: propose: change authenticator to use a single in-flight refresh locker (CompletableDeferred-like), and make retrofit/okhttp call path await it. Also add defensive check for 401->refresh->retry only once per request.
sam: Agree. Also add a compatibility test target on Android 12/13 in the CI matrix and add a smoke test that toggles pinning on/off.
kevin: quick patch idea:
```
private val tokenRefreshLock = AtomicReference<Deferred<String>?>(null)
suspend fun getFreshToken(): String {
  val existing = tokenRefreshLock.get()
  if (existing != null) return existing.await()
  val new = coroutineScope { async { refreshTokenFromNetwork() } }
  if (!tokenRefreshLock.compareAndSet(null, new)) return tokenRefreshLock.get()!!.await()
  try { return new.await() } finally { tokenRefreshLock.set(null) }
}
```
chloe: plus add an instrumentation test that simulates intermittent 401 + pinned cert handshake dropout.
maria: I've opened a draft PR (WIP) with the AtomicReference approach and a sample-app test. tagging @ci-bot to run android-emulator-13 job.
ci-bot: Build queued: android-emulator-13-smoke-suite #4821. ETA ~12m :gear:
sam: Once PR lands we should update CHANGELOG and call out the parity fix for Java/Kotlin SDKs so mobile teams can bump patch release.
maria: thanks — I'll add release notes & backport to 0.13.x branch. Also adding a short doc in devex/ samples about "Auth locker patterns for OkHttp + Retrofit".
